content: Pokemon catch formula (cross-checked: Bulbapedia, pokemon.fandom, Pokebattler, Oxford maths video): catch chance = f(species base catch rate, current HP / max HP, ball multiplier, status/berry multiplier, throw bonus, medals). Lower remaining HP raises catch chance (3x max HP - 2x current HP term). Pokemon GO multipliers: Razz Berry 1.5x, Golden Razz 2.5x, Great Ball 1.5x, Ultra Ball 2.0x, curve 1.7x, type medals 1.1-1.3x. Base catch rates range 3 (legendaries) to 255 (trivial). Satisfaction comes from: visible % feedback, escalating item investment for rare targets, and guaranteed-not-guaranteed tension. GO adds catch-combo/shiny-hunt mechanics (chain catches raise odds) to keep repeat encounters rewarding.
